capabilities: Display Habitica tasks, dailies, habits and rewards in a pane
Show HP, XP and coins stats
Check off and uncheck tasks, dailies and habits
Configure user ID, API token and display toggles in settings
disambiguation: It does not track habits in your notes; it mirrors an external Habitica account in a pane.
extras: Setup requires finding credentials in the Habitica webapp under Settings > API; README invites bug reports and donations and mentions a roadmap.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or check off tasks from a Habitica account without leaving the app.

requires.name: Habitica User ID and API token

summary: Habitica integration that adds a sidebar pane showing and interacting with your Habitica tasks, dailies, habits, rewards and stats.
